features.name: v1_recency_scaled
features.description: V1 scaled by the training-fold maximum; larger values indicate a longer elapsed period since the most recent donation event.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives the linear margin a normalized recency axis without relying on raw month scale.

features.name: v2_frequency_log_scaled
features.description: Log-scaled cumulative donation count V2, mapped from the training-fold count range 1 to 44 into a bounded score.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses the long-tailed count signal so large counts remain useful without dominating a linear margin.

features.name: v4_tenure_log_scaled
features.description: Log-scaled elapsed history length V4, mapped from the training-fold range 2 to 98 into a bounded score.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth history-length dimension and reduces sensitivity to very long tenures.

features.name: v1_v4_inactivity_history_share
features.description: Fraction of observed donor history represented by the elapsed time since the most recent donation, using a stabilized V4 denominator.
features.expected_model_benefit: Turns recency and history into a bounded inactivity severity score that a linear separator can weight directly.

features.name: v1_v4_active_span_scaled
features.description: Normalized span between first and most recent recorded donation events, clipped to handle any ordering anomalies.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures breadth of actual activity beyond raw tenure, adding an interpretable interaction for a linear margin.

features.name: v2_v4_donation_density_scaled
features.description: Cumulative donation count per elapsed history month, capped at one donation per month.
features.expected_model_benefit: Approximates activity rate as a bounded ratio, often more linear than raw count or duration.

features.name: v1_v2_recency_per_donation_scaled
features.description: Elapsed time since most recent donation divided by cumulative donation count and scaled by the maximum V1 value.
features.expected_model_benefit: Measures dormancy burden per repeat activity, a simple ratio that can improve linear ordering.

features.name: v2_v4_frequency_tenure_residual
features.description: Difference between unsupervised z-scored V2 and unsupervised z-scored V4, clipped to reduce outlier influence.
features.expected_model_benefit: Highlights unusually high or low count relative to history length as an approximate linear projection.

features.name: v3_v1_recent_volume_momentum
features.description: Product of log-scaled cumulative blood volume V3 and recentness from V1.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a smooth interaction between cumulative volume and recency that a purely linear model would not form by itself.

features.name: composite_engagement_index
features.description: Weighted bounded index combining recentness, log-scaled count, and log-scaled history length with fixed unsupervised weights.
features.expected_model_benefit: Offers a compact monotone engagement score that can stabilize the margin when individual axes are noisy.

features.name: semantic_donation_continuity_score
features.description: Score from 0.0 to 1.0 assigned using only V1, V2, V3, and V4: higher for repeated donations spread across a meaningful history with no long dormant tail; lower for one-off, very sparse, or highly dormant patterns.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a qualitative continuity assessment that can capture row-level patterns not fully represented by simple ratios.

features.name: semantic_operational_readiness_score
features.description: Score from 0.0 to 1.0 judging current engagement readiness from the row values: high when recentness, repeated donation count, cumulative volume, and history length jointly look strong; low when activity is old or sparse.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth expert-style signal for cases where formula features give conflicting evidence.
